# Retained pre-consolidation distribution

`pickup-install-before-consolidation.command` is the unchanged installer from Treasure commit `e847862537c3e7bc2c0d0681c41d79200a709613`.

SHA-256: `3e2595722f4a5c6b74c36fd06d54f0193db84be293a9e99a9ac5aca12cda8839`.

The upgrade test verifies this identity and extracts the archive as data. Only the external download table in the disposable extracted copy is replaced with fixture downloads. The historical installer code and skills install the old pair before the current installer updates it. This is fixture-scanner evidence, not current real scanner coverage. The retained artifact itself is never rewritten.
